contacts_of_the_read.scorer: 5 per pool (one complete official scoring per edited sample copy)

decision_rule: CLEARS iff intent CI95 lower bound > 0 AND intent delta >= floor AND SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound >= -floor; an arm with an in-chain A/A is registered only if the Fold A pool clears
floor: 0.67 * sqrt(625 / n): the instrument note's section 2d offline-sealed-pool floor scaled by scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py's own arithmetic

fold-a.stage_1_3_read: ABSENT at registration: analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-2-FOLD-A-READ-V1 is produced by scripts/flights/batch/roll2_read.sh (5 scorer jobs), which has not run and whose read row is not in the exposure ledger

r01c.reason: no agreement table was ever built for R01C; reading it needs a new model-free preparation

reach_ceiling.note: every marked row a gold catch-all and every edit a conversion; an upper bound, never a forecast

resampling.baseline: R0-mean-single (the mean of the five unedited sample copies' count matrices)
resampling.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(20260915).integers(0, n, size=(10000, n)); per-draw weights by bincount
resampling.source: docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md sections 2c and 2d (the one-pool offline floor, 0.67 pp at n = 625, from the aggregation read's medoid rule)
resampling.unit: row (paired: every arm re-summed on the same draws)

rule.decision: on a marked row every well-formed sample whose intent is not general_quirky is delivered as scenario general, action quirky; entities byte-unchanged; malformed samples and unmarked rows never edited
rule.mark: intent-boundary:general_quirky holds the strict maximum share (ties never mark)
rule.signal: agree-1: the row's self-excluded top-20 TRAIN-exemplar vote shares (saea-phase-agreement-v1), gold-free

stage3_algorithm.note: One fixed rule read once over a sealed pool: no rollout, no credit assignment, no update operator, no search and no evolving store. Deliberately NOT labelled sealed-credit-system-policy-v1, whose first instance every single-factor cell of this programme leaves to the composed system policy.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-CATCHALL-OFFLINE-V1.note: The smallest effect the read is registered to see (its floor at n = 1,080), not a forecast; reach ceiling 1.85 pp (20 marked rows). A clear licenses an arm with an in-chain A/A, never a gain claim.
SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-CATCHALL-OFFLINE-V1.primary_metric: intent accuracy (scenario_action_exact), RULE-mean-single minus R0-mean-single over the sealed ROLL-2 pool; official SLU-F1 the guard
